aspects.name: PolicyBoundProcess
aspects.text: Operates as a bounded, policy-driven workflow that must not invent missing contracts or executable invocations.

aspects.name: ContractConstrained
aspects.text: Requires explicit input/output contracts for worker handoffs; incomplete contracts should be reported as diagnostics rather than filled in.

aspects.name: SkeletonPreserving
aspects.text: Keeps the child worker definition as a renderable skeleton with empty INPUTS and OUTPUTS when contract details are absent.

concepts.definition: A workflow for quickly reviewing a user incident report and producing a brief triage response plus completion status.
The report provided by a user describing an incident that needs to be analyzed during triage.
A short response summarizing the initial assessment or handling of the incident.
A final status indicator showing whether the main worker has completed its task.
A separate bounded subtask worker created during processing; here it is named ComplianceAcknowledgement.
The required child worker that must be extracted by policy, but whose input and output contracts are intentionally unspecified.
The specification of what inputs a worker accepts.
The specification of what outputs a worker must produce.
The complete contract required before an executable worker invocation can be created.
The contract governing a worker invocation; if incomplete, diagnostics should report that it is incomplete.
